thread:
alex: @sre-oncall seeing pages not going out for ~7m, customers reporting missed alerts. notify-relay logs show a bunch of messages with suppress=true. anyone oncall? :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Alert: notify-relay CPU spike, dropped 204 messages in last 5m (auto-generated)
sre-oncall: I'm on it. alex send one or two sample alert IDs so I can look them up. pinging tom for rota mapping.
alex: sample IDs: 2026-ACME-438, 2026-ACME-439. snippet from relay pod logs:
```
2026-03-17T14:03:12Z notify-relay[pod-7] INFO drop_reason=suppressed ttl_state=stale route=oncall-east
2026-03-17T14:03:13Z notify-relay[pod-7] DEBUG rota_status=500 rota_err="upstream 500"
```
maya: checking redis streams/queue. seeing TTLs older than configured and relay is auto-suppressing when rota lookup fails.
tom: rota service returned 500 at 14:02:10, looks like DB pool exhaustion spike. if relay is configured to suppress on rota_error we're going to see this behavior. paging the rota team.
pagerbot: ERROR 14:02:10 Could not resolve oncall for team infra-east (HTTP 500 from rota-service)
natalie: relay config has `suppress_on_rota_error=true` in prod which causes this exact failure mode. should we flip to false while rota recovers?
maya: I can toggle via SSM. planning to set `suppress_on_rota_error=false` and reload config. Doing now.
ops-bot: notify-relay config reload succeeded (deploy/notify-relay rollout).
ops-bot: Retrying queued messages: total=198 retried; delivered=186; failed=12 (still queued)
sre-oncall: Manually paged ACME via /page ACME-critical, got ack from oncall.
tom: rota-service reports healthy now (200). root cause looks like a transient DB connection spike; opening infra ticket INFRA-452.
alex: customers affected: ACME (partial missed pages), BetaShop (1 missed page). Creating INC-987 and notifying CS.
ops-bot: Postmortem ticket created: https://redwood/internal/incidents/INC-987 :memo:
natalie: follow-ups: 1) change default behavior so relay does not suppress on rota errors, 2) add synthetic heartbeat/healthcheck for rota, 3) emit metric when relay suppression rate > 1/min, 4) increase queue TTL slightly to avoid immediate dropping on short rota blips.
maya: implemented temp config flip and added a short-lived monitor to watch suppression rate. will follow up with a PR to change default.
sre-oncall: i'll keep monitoring for 30m and verify no further missed pages. if anyone sees a reoccurrence ping me directly. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: (reaction) :eyes:
alex: thanks all. I'll update status page and CS with timeline and mitigation. meeting to discuss retro items tomorrow.
